title: Level 3 (Advanced) - C-23
notes:
West leads the ♠K against 3NT. West is marked with the ♥A and long spades for his 2♠ overcall of South's no trump bid. It appears that South will have to depend on the diamonds for his ninth trick (the ♠A, 3 top diamonds, and 4 top clubs will be South's other 8 tricks). If South plays on hearts, West will be able to win the ♥A and run the spades.

It cannot hurt for South to hold up the ♠A until the third round although this play is not necessary. South should then cash his 4 club tricks (South must be careful to discard hearts not diamonds from dummy). If West has 4 diamonds, he will be squeezed on the play of the fourth club. West must keep 4 diamonds and the ♥A in his last 6 cards. Therefore he must come down to a single spade winner.

South can now safely knock out the ♥A for his ninth trick. West will be able to take only 3 spade tricks and the ♥A.

Notice that if diamonds are tested before the last club is cashed the squeeze will not function. West can either discard a spade or a diamond and come down to all winners. West can afford to set up dummy's fourth diamond in this position as dummy lacks an entry to cash this trick.
